name: tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "19.0*"
  push:
    branches:
      - "19.0"
      - "19.0-ocabot-*"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  unreleased-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Detect unreleased dependencies
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: |
          for reqfile in requirements.txt test-requirements.txt ; do
              if [ -f ${reqfile} ] ; then
                  result=0
                  # reject non-comment lines that contain a / (i.e. URLs, relative paths)
                  grep "^[^#].*/" ${reqfile} || result=$?
                  if [ $result -eq 0 ] ; then
                      echo "Unreleased dependencies found in ${reqfile}."
                      exit 1
                  fi
              fi
          done
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    container: ${{ matrix.container }} # zizmor: ignore[unpinned-images]
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - container: ghcr.io/oca/oca-ci/py3.10-odoo19.0:latest
            name: test with Odoo
          - container: ghcr.io/oca/oca-ci/py3.10-ocb19.0:latest
            name: test with OCB
            makepot: "true"
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:13
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: odoo
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: odoo
          POSTGRES_DB: odoo
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    env:
      "OCA_ENABLE_CHECKLOG_ODOO": "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install addons and dependencies
        run: oca_install_addons
      - name: Check licenses
        run: manifestoo -d . check-licenses
      - name: Check development status
        run: manifestoo -d . check-dev-status --default-dev-status=Beta
      - name: Initialize test db
        run: oca_init_test_database
      - name: Run tests
        run: oca_run_tests
      - name: Upload screenshots from JS tests
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        with:
          name: Screenshots of failed JS tests - ${{ matrix.name }}${{ join(matrix.include) }}
          path: /tmp/odoo_tests/${{ env.PGDATABASE }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
      - name: Update .pot files
        run: oca_export_and_push_pot "https://x-access-token:${GIT_PUSH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
        env:
          GIT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GIT_PUSH_TOKEN }}
        if: matrix.makepot == 'true' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.repository_owner == 'OCA'

name: Checks

on:

  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
